_help: The cars to choose from. 'model' is a file in models/ (without .glb); 'length' is how long it is on the track, in metres (its width follows from the model). The rest are compared with the Stocker: 'top' speed, 'accel' (how quickly it gets there), 'grip' (how fast it can take a turn before sliding up) and 'weight' (who gets pushed around in a bump).

cars.name: Hot Hatch
cars.about: Quick off the line and nimble, but light in a shoving match.

cars.name: Prototype
cars.about: The fastest in a straight line. Slides when the turns get tight.

cars.name: Open Wheeler
cars.about: Sticks to the bottom of the turns. Don't trade paint with it.

cars.name: Pickup
cars.about: Slow to get going, but nobody moves it out of the way.

cars.name: Big SUV
cars.about: Heavy and planted. Wins every bump.
